hero.subtitle:
Wager Technik provides dedicated IT delivery teams under a capacity-based subcontracting model.
We own delivery quality, technical oversight, and outcomes, so you gain predictable capacity without hiring risk.
hero.disclaimer: We don't lease developers. We deliver outcomes with accountable teams.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.body1: Wager Technik is a subcontracting partner for organisations that already deliver technology and need to deliver more. We provide dedicated delivery teams that work alongside your organisation while Wager Technik remains fully accountable for delivery quality, technical standards, and outcomes.
whatWeDo.body2: We are not a staff augmentation provider. We deliver structured, outcome-focused engineering capacity.

modelTeaser.title: Our Model
modelTeaser.body: Wager Technik operates under a capacity-based subcontracting model. We remain responsible for delivery and quality at all times.
modelTeaser.disclaimer: Wager Technik does not provide body leasing or staff augmentation services.

cta.body: Partner with a team that takes full accountability for delivery quality, technical oversight, and outcomes.

about.heroSubtitle: We are a dedicated IT delivery partner focused on bringing reliable engineering capacity to ambitious companies.
about.leadershipBody1: With deep roots in software engineering and technical leadership, our founding philosophy revolves around bridging the gap between talent and structured delivery.
about.leadershipBody2: We believe in building operational models that empower engineers to do their best work while guaranteeing accountability, predictability, and high-quality results for our partners.
about.philosophySubtitle: The core principles that guide our work, shape our teams, and define our partnerships.
about.qualityBody: We do not compromise on engineering standards. High-quality code and robust architecture are the foundation of sustainable software products.
about.accountabilityBody: We take full ownership of the delivery process. When we commit to a project or capacity, we guarantee reliable and predictable outcomes.
about.partnershipsBody: We build lasting relationships based on trust, total transparency, and a shared commitment to achieving your business goals.
about.locationsSubtitle: Combining strict German accountability with exceptional global engineering talent.
about.germanyBody: Our headquarters and the centre of our operations, legal compliance, and strategic management. We bring German accountability, solid legal frameworks, and structured processes to every engagement.
about.remoteBody: We source vetted, top-tier engineering talent globally. Our remote delivery centres are integrated seamlessly into our strict quality and management frameworks to ensure peak performance.

services.heroSubtitle: Structured IT delivery, project execution, and technical leadership — designed to give you more capacity with less operational risk.
services.dedicatedBody: Fully formed engineering units integrated seamlessly into your workflow. We take full ownership of the delivery process to drive continuous value.
services.dedicatedWhatBody: A cohesive team of vetted engineers, managed by Wager Technik, entirely focused on your technical objectives.
services.dedicatedHowBody: We map your capacity needs, assemble the team, and take ongoing responsibility for the execution pipeline.
services.dedicatedWhenBody: Ideal for long-term product development or when you need to scale capacity quickly without the overhead of internal hiring.
services.projectBody: End-to-end execution for well-defined technical initiatives. We turn your requirements into delivered, high-quality software.
services.fixedScopeBody: Clear deliverables, structured timelines, and predictable costs established confidently from day one.
services.milestonesBody: Phased delivery approaches that ensure transparency, adaptability, and regular value creation.
services.pilotBody: Low-risk initial engagements designed to prove our delivery model before scaling up the partnership.
services.techLeadershipSubtitle: Building your technology strategy and ensuring high standards of engineering excellence across your organisation.
services.architectureBody: Designing scalable, secure, and maintainable system architectures tailored to your long-term business goals.
services.codeQualityBody: Establishing rigorous standards, conducting comprehensive code reviews, and maintaining strict technical hygiene.
services.hiringSupportBody: Assisting in technical evaluations, interviewing processes, and building internal capabilities alongside our teams.

howWeWork.heroSubtitle: A proven, structured delivery model that integrates seamlessly into your business — balancing transparency with independent execution.
howWeWork.deliveryBody: We manage the complexities of software delivery so you don't have to. You maintain vision and direction, while we handle execution.
howWeWork.ownsDeliveryBody: We take complete responsibility for the development process, timeline, and the final output quality.
howWeWork.clientCollabBody: You provide the goals and business context. We collaborate closely but spare you the daily management overhead.
howWeWork.commBody: Radical transparency and clear reporting ensure you always know the exact status of your project without needing to ask.
howWeWork.weeklyUpdatesBody: Regular syncs and concise updates on progress, current blockers, and upcoming next steps.
howWeWork.reportingBody: Comprehensive sprint reports and metric-driven insights into team velocity and project health.
howWeWork.transparencyBody: Open access to our agile boards, code repositories, and decision logs. No black boxes.
howWeWork.qaSubtitle: Built-in engineering excellence applied rigorously at every stage of the software development lifecycle.
howWeWork.codeReviewsBody: Mandatory peer reviews ensure high maintainability, ironclad security, and strict adherence to industry best practices.
howWeWork.techOversightBody: Dedicated senior technical leaders actively oversee system architecture and resolve the most complex engineering challenges.
howWeWork.standardsBody: Implementation of strict CI/CD pipelines, automated testing suites, and uniform coding standards across all projects.

ourModel.heroSubtitle: A specialised partnership designed to eliminate operational friction and deliver immediate technical value.
ourModel.howModelBody: We take on specific work packages or provide entire software capacities under our own management and responsibility.
ourModel.subcontractingBody: We take on specific work packages or provide entire software capacities under our own management and responsibility.
ourModel.deliveryFocusedBody: Our commitment is to the successful delivery of software, not just tracking hours. We manage the process, the people, and the quality.
ourModel.notSubtitle: Clarity is key to our partnership. We strictly avoid models that introduce compliance risks or dilute responsibility.
ourModel.notStaffBody: We don't loan out individual developers to be micro-managed by your team.
ourModel.notBodyBody: We operate strictly under service contracts, avoiding the risks of temporary employee leasing.
ourModel.notFreelancerBody: We provide cohesive, permanent teams. We are not a broker for independent contractors.
ourModel.whyBody: Our approach eliminates the common friction points in traditional IT outsourcing by establishing clear boundaries and ownership.
ourModel.legalClarityBody: Clear contractual boundaries that protect both parties and comply fully with strict European labour laws.
ourModel.accountabilityBody: We own the delivery process, the technical debt, and the ultimate quality of the output.
ourModel.predictabilityBody: Transparent costs, defined capacities, and reliable delivery cadences that you can plan your business around.
ourModel.engagementSubtitle: A structured, risk-free onboarding process designed to build trust and prove value early.
ourModel.discoveryDesc: We align on your technical needs, current challenges, and the required delivery capacity.
ourModel.pilotDesc: A short, scoped initial engagement to demonstrate our capabilities, processes, and code quality.
ourModel.deliveryDesc: The core engagement phase where our dedicated team integrates and begins consistent output.
ourModel.scaleDesc: Flexible expansion of team size and responsibilities as your business requirements grow.
